decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed door to the garage from the garden shall be four panelled and a drawing  shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the work is commenced.

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
Condition : 4 - Details of the proposed roller shutter shall be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works hereby approved are commenced.
description: Installation of vehicular crossover from British Grove Passage to existing dwellinghouse
